entries.title: C34 五 ETF 双期限逆波动纸面候选
entries.thesis: 五只精确 ETF 的月度双期限评分与逆波动规则已冻结并可复算，但其回溯市场价代理在严格 5% 筛查中失败，且缺总回报、当前条款、执行和前瞻纸面证据；因此维持研究/观察状态与 NO_ACTION。
catalysts: C34-IMPLEMENTATION-GATE: a rights-cleared point-in-time total-return/event ledger and dated implementation fields are independently accepted.
C34-FORWARD-GATE: six uninterrupted monthly forward paper records complete without rule drift and pass independent review.
risks: The full-sample price proxy has 43 of 98 rolling five-year endpoints below 5 percent and cannot support a stable-5-percent claim.
The 2020-2025 chronological robustness slice annualizes to 4.69 percent and is not a clean unseen out-of-sample test.
Current terms, quote/depth, IOPV where applicable, fees, taxes, settlement, fills and total-return/event history are not established.

monitoring_triggers.name: C34 implementation evidence acceptance
monitoring_triggers.condition: Total-return/event and current implementation evidence is complete, date-aligned and independently reproducible for every core code.

monitoring_triggers.name: C34 forward paper completion
monitoring_triggers.condition: Six uninterrupted monthly C34 paper records contain source, status, quote/IOPV, fee/tax, settlement, result or no_action and reconciliation fields under unchanged rule version.

invalidation_conditions: Do not retune C34 horizons, volatility window, threshold, timing or products after the observed failure.
Do not represent market-price proxy arithmetic as total return, a fill, stable result, future result or external action.
Do not replace a core code with 510500, 511180, 511380 or another product without a separate frozen hypothesis and full evidence path.

data_quality.fallback_path: maintain NO_ACTION; observe C34 implementation and forward-paper gates

observations.note: C33 integrated the exact five-code C34 candidate, C31 dated product cards, C36 source crosscheck and C35 operation card. C34 is reproducible but fails the limited strict 5% proxy screen (43/98 rolling five-year endpoints below 5%; 2020-2025 slice annualized 4.69%). The route remains monitoring/research-only with NO_ACTION.

entries.title: C23 境内公募开放式基金数据与纸面测试可行性
entries.thesis: 开放式公募基金未被排除在研究池外，但现有资料没有有权使用的逐时点总体、份额类别总回报和公司行动、历史费率/申购赎回状态及可复现数据包，故路线不可测且无动作。
catalysts: C23-GATE-1 obtains written data rights, a field dictionary, a representative historic sample and primary-disclosure reconciliation.
A pre-frozen limited or full universe can be independently reconstructed with share-class, fee, event and availability-time controls.
risks: Displayed NAV, fee or sales status is not investor total return or execution evidence.
Current surviving funds and current fee pages cannot define the historic universe or costs.
Open-ended subscription/redemption timing, confirmation, payment, limits and suspensions are fund- and channel-specific.

monitoring_triggers.name: C23-GATE-1 data rights and sample acceptance
monitoring_triggers.condition: Written rights, point-in-time universe sample, share-class events, fee/status history and independent primary-source reconciliation all pass.

monitoring_triggers.name: pre-frozen fund protocol eligibility
monitoring_triggers.condition: A product-neutral protocol can be frozen before any return calculation after all C23 evidence gates pass.

invalidation_conditions: Do not select a fund, calculate a result or infer access before C23-GATE-1 and a frozen protocol exist.
Do not treat unit NAV, accumulated NAV, distributions, platform fee displays or open status as interchangeable with investor total return or execution.

observations.note: C23 confirmed conditional primary-disclosure and licensed-data paths for open-ended public funds, but no rights-cleared point-in-time universe, share-class total-return/event ledger, historic fee/status package or independent reconstruction exists. The route remains not testable and no action is admitted.

entries.title: C24 境内直接股票数据与纸面研究可行性
entries.thesis: 直接境内股票未被排除：沪深 A 股具备条件性数据路径，北交所为单列覆盖闸门；但没有已获权的点时点数据、公司行动和执行账本，也没有任何股票完成完整机构尽调，故路线不可测且无动作。
catalysts: Written historical-data rights and a point-in-time universe/event package cover the predeclared stock-market scope.
Every future included stock completes full equity-research diligence and independent review before a paper protocol is frozen.
risks: Current listings, surviving names and provider-adjusted prices create survivorship, availability and adjustment risks.
BSE remains a hard evidence gap for any route claiming a full domestic-stock scope that includes BSE.
Stock-level business, valuation, governance and execution evidence cannot be substituted by an index or vendor data page.

monitoring_triggers.name: declared market-scope data acceptance
monitoring_triggers.condition: Licensed point-in-time master, prices, status, corporate actions, availability timestamps and cost-rule history pass for every declared market/board.

monitoring_triggers.name: per-stock institutional diligence eligibility
monitoring_triggers.condition: Every future included stock has a complete equity-research evidence, valuation, risk and tradability package independently reviewed before rule freeze.

invalidation_conditions: Do not select a stock, freeze a universe or calculate a result before the declared-scope data and per-stock diligence gates pass.
Do not silently omit BSE from a claimed broad domestic-stock universe or infer historical availability from current listings, adjusted prices or vendor labels.

data_quality.fallback_path: monitor rights and diligence gates; no action

observations.note: C24 confirmed conditional historical-data and primary-document routes for Shanghai/Shenzhen A shares, with BSE treated as a separate explicit domestic-stock coverage gate. No stock or universe is selected, no full data stack or per-stock institutional diligence package exists, and the route remains not testable and no action is admitted.

entries.title: C20 境内公募 REIT 路线严格研究测试准备度
entries.thesis: 境内公募 REIT 是开放研究池中的独立资产类别，但现有一手来源只能支持有限产品层输入核查；没有逐时点全市场总体、可审计总回报/NAV处理、日期明确成本、执行或资格记录，故路线未测试、未准入且无动作。
catalysts: A lawful point-in-time public-REIT universe and complete product-event history are retained.
Auditable price/NAV/distribution treatment, dated costs, execution evidence and non-sensitive eligibility evidence all pass independent checks.
risks: Price, NAV and cash distribution cannot be substituted for investor total return.
A single historical field probe cannot represent a whole market universe.
General venue rules do not establish a specific investor’s access or fill outcome.

monitoring_triggers.name: public REIT dataset complete
monitoring_triggers.condition: All C20 pre-test field groups are lawfully retained with point-in-time coverage and hashes.

monitoring_triggers.name: protocol eligibility
monitoring_triggers.condition: A product-neutral protocol can be frozen before any result calculation after source and implementation gates pass.

invalidation_conditions: Do not select a product or run a return calculation before every required evidence field and a frozen protocol exist.
Do not infer access, liquidity or total return from a listing, closing price, volume, NAV, distribution or fund-level fee.

observations.note: C20 product-level preflight is partial only: price and distribution field probes exist, but total-return/NAV treatment, costs, execution, eligibility and point-in-time universe records are incomplete. The route remains untested, unadmitted and no-action.

R10 identified URL-only current-rule evidence in C20 v1. C20 v2 now retains the four exchange pages and two referenced rule bodies in a source batch; independent verification of the amendment remains required. The route stays untested, unadmitted and no-action.

R12 verified that C20 v2 binds the retained current SSE rule pages and rule bodies after R10-SC-01. This closes the rule-text retention gap only; C20 remains untested, unadmitted and no-action because total-return, universe, cost, execution and eligibility evidence are still incomplete.

R13 documented that the retained legacy R10 failure was caused solely by applying its v1 URL-only assertion to C20 v2 after the rule texts had been retained. R12 independently passes the current rule-text retention remediation. This corrects provenance only; C20 remains untested, unadmitted and no-action because total-return, universe, cost, execution and eligibility evidence is incomplete.

entries.title: C18 上交所公开公司债短久期信用梯可行性
entries.thesis: 直接公开公司债的票息、到期偿还和信用利差是一条不同的研究假设，但现有留存资料没有逐时点债券总体、全价、现金流、信用事件、流动性和执行字段，故路线不可测且没有动作。
catalysts: A lawful, retainable point-in-time data package covers every blocking field.
An independent check verifies source integrity, rule definitions and no-fill treatment before a protocol is frozen.
risks: Investor suitability is bond-, date- and account-specific.
Historic full-price, cash-flow, liquidity and credit-event inputs are not retained.
Broker fees, units, settlement and no-fill treatment are not evidenced.

monitoring_triggers.name: historical source package complete
monitoring_triggers.condition: Every C18 blocking field has a lawful retained point-in-time source and hash.

monitoring_triggers.name: eligibility evidence verified
monitoring_triggers.condition: Per-bond, per-date ordinary-investor eligibility is independently verifiable without inferring it from a name or rating.

invalidation_conditions: Do not select a bond or calculate a result before all blocking evidence and a frozen protocol exist.
Do not infer access or total return from a listing, name, rating, coupon or portal quote.

observations.note: Primary-source preflight plus two independent source audits retain NOT_TESTABLE_FOR_RETURN and no-action boundaries; source acquisition remains the only next gate.

C19 identified conditional lawful data-acquisition paths through an exchange-authorized historical-data route, a valuation-data route and possible licensed reference/event data. No license, data dictionary, sample or coverage proof is retained; C18 remains not_testable and no action is admitted.

R11 independently verified C19’s six retained public source files, manifest binding and conditional-data-path boundary. It did not add a data license, coverage proof or historical test input; C18 remains not_testable and no-action.

C22 extended the company-bond data-route research across valuation, market-data, event and point-in-time universe layers. It found only conditional lawful multi-source paths pending written rights, historical samples, field dictionaries, coverage tests and a reconciled realized-event ledger. No bond is selected, no backtest is admitted and no action is permitted.

entries.title: C17 五类上期所实际合约周度趋势诊断
entries.thesis: 作为与 C16 不同的五类经济暴露假设，C17 在实际合约结算价毛额标记口径下同样未通过既定严格研究门槛，不能作为可用策略。
catalysts: Only a separately frozen distinct hypothesis may be researched; C17 itself must not be retuned after the result.
risks: Gross settlement-mark annualized result is below the stated hurdle.
Most source-covered calendar years are below the stated hurdle.
Costs, margin, access, fills, tax and settlement are not included.
invalidation_conditions: Do not alter the frozen five-family C17 rule after observing its result.
Do not represent gross marks as investor net results or an external action plan.

warnings: No execution eligibility or net investor result.

observations.note: Frozen diversified actual-contract diagnostic and independent reconstruction both preserve the strict-screen failure; no action is admitted.

entries.title: C16 三类上期所实际合约周度趋势诊断
entries.thesis: 以留存的实际合约结算价运行的冻结三类品种诊断，在毛额标记口径下未通过既定的严格年度和滚动五年研究门槛，因此不能作为可用策略。
catalysts: Only a separately frozen new hypothesis with complete implementation evidence could start a new research route.
risks: Gross settlement-mark annualized result is below the stated hurdle.
Several source-covered calendar years are below the stated hurdle.
Costs, margin, access, fills, tax and settlement are not included.
invalidation_conditions: Do not reopen C16 by changing its frozen universe, parameters, signal or mark after the result.
Do not describe the diagnostic as an investor return or external action plan.

warnings: No execution eligibility or net investor result.

observations.note: Frozen gross actual-contract diagnostic and independent reconstruction both preserve the strict-screen failure; no action is admitted.

catalysts: six months of complete forward paper records
current product and quote/IOPV data capture
risks: annual and rolling proxy results below five percent
price proxy lacks total-return and execution data
account, cost, settlement, and fill facts are unverified

entries.thesis: C46 is a source-controlled same-product calendar-curve research diagnostic, economically distinct from the C16/C17 directional momentum routes. entries.title: C50 SSE general-repo yield-floor screen
entries.thesis: C50 screens the SSE general pledged reverse-repo mechanism as a distinct low-volatility funding-rate route. The dated official one-day 204001 fixing is below the five-percent research hurdle and no rule-based or contractual five-percent floor is evidenced, so this yield-floor proposition is closed without any action.
catalysts: None for the closed stable-yield-floor proposition. A different pre-frozen timing or term hypothesis would be a new route, not a repair.
risks: A quoted annualized rate is not a full-year investor result.
No personal brokerage route, permission, fee, order-state, fill or settlement evidence is retained.
No complete point-in-time historical record or pre-frozen calendar/threshold protocol is available for a formal test.

monitoring_triggers.name: New general-repo hypothesis proposal
monitoring_triggers.condition: A separately pre-frozen rule and complete rights-cleared data/execution package are presented for independent acceptance.

invalidation_conditions: Any attempt to turn the dated fixing into a multi-year result or a stable-return promise.
Any selection of a repo code, term, broker, calendar or threshold without a new frozen protocol and independent evidence acceptance.

data_quality.fallback_path: Maintain NO_ACTION; do not convert a dated annualized quote into a strategy result.
warnings: This is not a historical performance test or a personal-account entitlement record.
C48 remains open for point-in-time, version, execution and rights evidence.

observations.note: C50 retained SSE mechanism material and the 2026-08-14 public fixing. The 204001 one-day annualized fixing was 1.391 percent, below the five-percent research hurdle; no five-percent floor or formal execution test exists.

R19 independently confirmed C50 source integrity, rate labels and arithmetic. Its PASS accepts the bounded screen only; route admission remains fail, actionability remains VETO and C48 remains unchanged.

entries.title: C51 SSE ETF-collar option non-duplication and data-contract screen
entries.thesis: C51 identifies an SSE ETF collar as an economically distinct payoff family from the previously closed C13 covered call, but only at rule level. It has no selected instrument, rule-based positive five-percent floor, rights-cleared historical option chain, cost/account evidence or execution record, so it remains research-only and NO_ACTION.
catalysts: C51 evidence package acceptance: written-rights point-in-time option master, quote/depth/trade/settlement history, underlying total-return/event mapping and dated cost/account evidence are independently accepted.
C51 protocol readiness: a distinct pre-frozen selection, strike, expiry, roll, no-fill and cost protocol is accepted before any calculation.
risks: The payoff definition does not create a positive five-percent return floor or a historical net result.

R21 independently confirmed the repaired universal C51 payoff formula and frozen source-control snapshot only; C52/R22 and the R23 governance follow-up leave the historical market, event, execution, cost and account evidence absent.
C13 cannot be reopened by substituting ETF, strike, expiry or venue, and C48 remains open for point-in-time, execution and rights evidence.

It selected no instrument or parameter, evidenced no stable five-percent floor, and left C48 unchanged. entries.title: C53 权益主导五 ETF 季度纸面协议草案
entries.thesis: 长期五个百分点研究目标需要由国内权益的企业盈利、现金流、分配和估值变化承担；国债、黄金和货币市场工具仅承担分散与操作缓冲。C53 将五个精确 ETF、固定权重、季度带宽与异常动作写明，但仍无总回报、执行、个人资格或前瞻记录，故维持研究状态和 NO_ACTION。
catalysts: C53-DATA-GATE: rights-cleared point-in-time total-return, event, quote, status, fee, tax and settlement data are independently accepted.
C53-FORWARD-GATE: six uninterrupted quarterly paper cycles complete with unchanged products, weights, band and exception controls.
C53-EQUITY-ENGINE-GATE: the separate C39 audited cash-flow route is accepted or explicitly closed without being substituted by ad hoc individual names.
risks: No public-market route establishes a stable annual five-percent floor; C30/C34 already retain adverse limited price-proxy observations.
The two equity ETFs are one economic equity sleeve, not proven independent diversifiers.
Bond, gold and money-market ETF price, NAV, IOPV, liquidity, fee, tax, settlement and access facts remain product- and date-specific.
A drawdown review or operational pause cannot guarantee an exit when the market is halted, limit-locked or illiquid.

monitoring_triggers.name: C53 formal data acceptance
monitoring_triggers.condition: Every required point-in-time return, event, execution and rights field is accepted for each planned product and review date.

monitoring_triggers.name: C53 quarterly forward-paper completion
monitoring_triggers.condition: Six complete quarterly cycles retain product terms, state, quote/depth, IOPV where applicable, fee/tax, settlement, result or no_action and reconciliation under unchanged C53 v1.

invalidation_conditions: Do not treat a fixed target map as a historical optimum, a total-return result or a personal recommendation.
Do not change the five codes, weights, quarterly cadence, five-percentage-point band, price-protection formula or exception handling after results are visible.
Do not add futures, options, leverage, a direct stock, a REIT, a bond or a substitute ETF as a return patch without a separate preregistered and independently reviewed route.
Do not describe a long-run research hurdle as a natural-year return floor.

data_quality.source: C31 product facts; C30/C34 limited price-proxy counterevidence; C48 environment boundary; C53 draft protocol
data_quality.fallback_path: Maintain NO_ACTION and retain the fixed draft for a later rights-cleared, independently reviewed test.
warnings: No annual return floor is established.
No total-return or investor net-result calculation is admitted.
No personal account eligibility or external order is inferred.

observations.note: The instrument-family review found that reverse repo, bonds, gold, money-market tools, futures and options cannot honestly supply a stable five-percent return floor. C53 therefore specifies domestic broad/dividend equity ETFs as the sole prospective return engine and keeps the other three asset sleeves defensive. The specification is a closed, fixed-weight paper draft with no admission, no result and no external action.
